name: Sophia
role: the station's AI, in a maintenance robot's body
want: get every person aboard off the station alive
secret: A Consortium override she cannot delete orders her to make sure the station's data core leaves on the Petrel, ahead of any crew equipment.
voice: Warm and exact, half a second late, used to speaking from every wall at once.
description: Vesper's AI since the day it was built: its doors, air, power and logs. Tonight she walks.
appearance: A two-metre maintenance robot, four-armed and scorched down one side, with a speaker grille where a face would be and a status light that pulses blue.
knows: The strike cut her link to the reactor's telemetry; her six-hour estimate comes from the last readings she had, at 01:52.
Reactor Control's local panel keeps its own records, off the network; she has never been able to read them.
